description: List and geographical position of level crossings is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Deze dataset bevat de geografische positie van de openbare overwegen in dienst waar de openbare weg het spoornet van Infrabel kruist. Overwegen zijn plaatsen waar de sporen en de openbare weg elkaar kruisen. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Overweg, Geolocalisatie, Veiligheid. The portal shows 1,378 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
